name: CHONK
description: Physically modeled electric bass monosynth, ported from OneTrick CHONK (Punk Labs LLC). One waveguide string with a movable pickup; finger/pick/slap styles, palm mute, legato, glide and slide keyswitches, alternate picking with down/up voicing, a Ring release control, 5-band EQ and saturation. 9 factory presets. GPL-3.0-or-later.
